title: Atmosphere
description: Atmosphere's original landscape, cool white clock and quiet horizontal dock for Clean Your TV on LG webOS.

evidence.summary: Atmosphere 1.0.0 pinned descriptor and every declared resource verified locally and remotely. Chromium at 1920x1080 in Root and No-root with synthetic apps and external network blocked: Home focus/navigation, reorder/cancel, app library labels, Inputs and standard Settings isolation passed. Supplied preview visually compared with current Home rendering. Physical TV not tested.
